# Third-party packages

- `FAST_LIO`: vendored and adapted for ROS 2 in this repository.
- `livox_ros_driver2`: vendored from `https://github.com/Livox-SDK/livox_ros_driver2` so a normal `git clone` contains the Livox ROS 2 message package and driver sources.

Build from the repository root with `colcon build` in a ROS 2 workspace.
